job_target.name: job_target
job_target.value: ("analysis_job"."scan_id" IS NOT NULL AND "analysis_job"."consumption_id" IS NULL AND "analysis_job"."kind" IN ('photo_analysis','correction')) OR ("analysis_job"."scan_id" IS NULL AND "analysis_job"."consumption_id" IS NOT NULL AND "analysis_job"."kind" = 'consumption_evaluation')

job_processing_lease.name: job_processing_lease
job_processing_lease.value: "analysis_job"."status" <> 'processing' OR ("analysis_job"."lease_token" IS NOT NULL AND "analysis_job"."lease_expires_at" IS NOT NULL)

catalog_nutrients_nonnegative.name: catalog_nutrients_nonnegative
catalog_nutrients_nonnegative.value: ("catalog_food"."energy_kcal" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."energy_kcal" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."energy_kcal" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."carbohydrate_g" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."carbohydrate_g" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."carbohydrate_g" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."protein_g" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."protein_g" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."protein_g" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."fat_g" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."fat_g" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."fat_g" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."fiber_g" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."fiber_g" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."fiber_g" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."sugars_g" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."sugars_g" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."sugars_g" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("catalog_food"."sodium_mg" IS NULL OR "catalog_food"."sodium_mg" >= 0 AND "catalog_food"."sodium_mg" <> 'NaN'::numeric)

consumption_active_default_confirmation.name: consumption_active_default_confirmation
consumption_active_default_confirmation.where: "consumption"."source" = 'photo_confirmation' AND "consumption"."confirmation_mode" = 'default' AND "consumption"."deleted_at" IS NULL AND "consumption"."scan_id" IS NOT NULL

consumption_source.name: consumption_source
consumption_source.value: "consumption"."source" IN ('manual','photo_confirmation') AND ("consumption"."source" <> 'manual' OR ("consumption"."scan_id" IS NULL AND "consumption"."source_analysis_result_id" IS NULL))

exam_measurements.name: exam_measurements
exam_measurements.value: ("examination"."type" = 'pressure' AND "examination"."unit" = 'mmHg' AND "examination"."systolic" > 0 AND "examination"."diastolic" > 0 AND "examination"."systolic" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."diastolic" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."value" IS NULL AND "examination"."subtype" IS NULL AND "examination"."context" IS NULL) OR ("examination"."type" = 'glucose' AND "examination"."unit" = 'mg/dL' AND "examination"."value" > 0 AND "examination"."value" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "examination"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."context" IN ('fasting','random','post_meal','unknown') AND "examination"."context" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."subtype" IS NULL AND "examination"."systolic" IS NULL AND "examination"."diastolic" IS NULL) OR ("examination"."type" = 'cholesterol' AND "examination"."unit" = 'mg/dL' AND "examination"."value" > 0 AND "examination"."value" <> 'NaN'::numeric AND "examination"."value" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."subtype" IN ('total','ldl','hdl') AND "examination"."subtype" IS NOT NULL AND "examination"."context" IS NULL AND "examination"."systolic" IS NULL AND "examination"."diastolic" IS NULL)

profile_measurements_positive.name: profile_measurements_positive
profile_measurements_positive.value: ("health_profile"."height_cm" IS NULL OR "health_profile"."height_cm" > 0 AND "health_profile"."height_cm" <> 'NaN'::numeric) AND ("health_profile"."weight_kg" IS NULL OR "health_profile"."weight_kg" > 0 AND "health_profile"."weight_kg" <> 'NaN'::numeric)
